content.text: SearchRouteLog in toMy Mapy CategoriesMore categoriesTravel tipsRestaurantsAccommodationsATMLog inand your search history and preferred categories will appear here.ClosePanoramaPhotosWebcam3D viewDiego GarciaIslandBritish Indian Ocean Territory Directions SaveShareTrip Suggest a correctionDiego Garcia is the largest island in the Chagos Archipelago, a British Indian Ocean Territory with a complex history. Initially uninhabited, it was used for coconut plantations and as a leper colony before becoming a joint UK-U.S. military base in the 1970s, following the controversial displacement of its original inhabitants, the Chagossians. Strategically located in the central Indian Ocean, it’s nicknamed the "Footprint of Freedom" by the US Navy and serves as a key military installation. Discussions are currently underway regarding potential sovereignty transfer to Mauritius, though a long-term lease for the base is anticipated. population:4,202named after:Diego García de Moguerarea:30 km²archipelago:Chagos Archipelagolies in:Indian OceanData sourcesAdd photoOther links:en.wikipedia.orgGPS7.3383586S, 72.4718156E`CopyWGS84 (degrees) 20. 2. 2026When updating offline maps, you now only download a portion of the map.
